reason: The complete original supports the three-unit inventory. EO9514 substantively displaces the original unqualified proviso in 1945 while reenacting the general regulatory grant; the claim expressly distinguishes the narrowed remainder. EO12292 section10(a) revokes the order and section11 makes that action effective February15,1981. The original grant and publication delegation have no earlier cessation in their own terms or the material located sources. Numeric and broader named-office/subject searches, actual source identification, all cited quotes and fixity were independently checked. No concrete contradictory event or surviving independent command of this order remains unresolved within the disclosed bounded search.

clause_findings.finding: Indefinite authority to regulate Foreign Service officers and employees and their business, limited by the Constitution, law and other Executive orders or proclamations. EO9514 materially reenacts this same grant. A new specific statutory delegation, compensation rule, or assignment to another agency does not itself terminate this general authority.

Accepted with the precise scope already stated in the candidate: the original unqualified prohibition on exercising authority specifically committed to the President by statute loses its RS1752 application when EO9514 excepts that provision. The remaining restriction continues in the amended version until1981; this is not a finding that all statutory limits disappeared in1945. The 1945 date is supported by substantive displacement, not merely a new printed version or completed execution of an amendment.

The form/publication delegation is unchanged by EO9514 and has no own-term sunset. Its reservation of independent Federal Register publication requirements is a limitation, not creation of a separate perpetual command after revocation.

inventory_assessment: Both original numbered paragraphs are fully represented. Paragraph1 is split at the exact Provided, however boundary to distinguish the grant from its original blanket proviso. Original preamble and signature are contextual; adjacent dairy/agency material is not EO9452. Three contiguous exact original quotes pass; no original operative provision omitted.

savings_residuals_assessment.reason: Original publication law reservation and other-law consistency limits do not independently continue this delegation after express revocation. EO9514 contains no independent saving. EO9521 nonrevival proviso applies to its other named orders. EO12292 contains no target saving. Other read instruments supply distinct statutory functions or preserve actions under those functions. No saved continuing command of EO9452 was found.
savings_residuals_assessment.limits: This finding does not invalidate completed acts, accrued legal positions, or all regulations formerly made under9452. A separately lawful downstream regulation is not automatically an operative command of the revoked enabling order. No full historical survey of every implementing regulation is claimed.
